description.value: H'aiagal'ath Grizzly Bear Tours is an Indigenous-owned and operated ecotourism company run by the W'ui'kinuxv people, offering grizzly bear viewing and cultural immersion experiences deep in the Great Bear Rainforest along Rivers Inlet. The operation is rooted in over 14,000 years of W'ui'kinuxv stewardship of the land and follows strict science-based ecotourism protocols to minimize impact on bears and habitat. Guests access the remote W'ui'kinuxv Village by float plane or water taxi from Port Hardy, making this a wilderness destination rather than a roadside stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming this is a real, operating Indigenous-owned ecotourism business offering grizzly bear tours in Rivers Inlet, BC. The contact page confirms the phone number (250.902.8886) and email. No OSM tags were available, and the website contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities — all such fields default to null. The operation is extremely remote (accessible only by float plane or water taxi from Port Hardy), so cycling access is not a meaningful factor, but the business is real and active.
concerns: No OSM tags available for this record — sourced via manual addition only.
Location is accessible only by float plane or water taxi; effectively inaccessible by bicycle, but included per directory scope.
